tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product variant to the shopping cart. Requires the numeric variant_id (found via get_product_details). Returns updated cart summary.

variant_id.description: The numeric ID of the variant to add

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: View the current shopping cart contents including items, quantities, prices, and subtotal. All prices are in AUD and include GST.

tools.name: get_collection_products
tools.description: Get all products in a specific collection by its URL handle. Returns products with prices and stock status.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific product by its URL handle (slug). Returns title, description, variants with prices/stock, options, and images. Handles look like 'raspberry-pi-5-8gb' (the part after /products/ in the URL).

tools.name: get_shipping_estimate
tools.description: Get shipping rate estimates for the current cart to an Australian postcode. Cart must have items. Returns available shipping methods with prices.

postcode.description: Australian postcode (e.g. '2000' for Sydney, '3000' for Melbourne)

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get store contact information, business details, and policies. Includes phone, email, address, ABN, accepted payment methods, and links to policy pages.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all product collections (categories) in the store. Returns collection names, handles, and product counts.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove an item from the cart entirely. Use get_cart first to find the cart item ID.

cart_item_id.description: The cart item ID to remove (from get_cart response)

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Little Bird Electronics product catalog by keyword. Returns product names, prices, stock status, and URLs. All prices are in AUD and include GST.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Update the quantity of an item already in the cart. Use get_cart first to find the cart item ID. Set quantity to 0 to remove the item.

cart_item_id.description: The cart item ID (from get_cart response)
